newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: UNITRANS DROPS AFTER YEAR RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: UNITRANS DROPS AFTER YEAR RESULTS.

text.p: Shares in South African transport firm Unitrans Ltd on Thursday fell after the firm posted a drop in headline year earnings per share to 106.6 cents from 128.9 cents last time.
The firm's stock dropped 110 cents to 19.40 rand by 0735 GMT.
The company published its results after the close of trading on Wednesday and said its disappointing scond half performance had been lower than expected.
The firm had also been hit by a three week sugar industry strike which brought haulage operations to a standstill during July.
"It is down on the results," said one trader, but he pointed to a low volume of just 4,900 shares.

Unitrans, which upped its dividend to 53.0 cents from 51.0 cents, however, said its business remained strong and all its operating subsidiaries were projecting improved performances in the year ahead.
